# HarnessDock v0.2.3

v0.2.3 fixes Windows startup with system Node and hardens the direct Web UI boot path.

## Windows Runtime

- Normalizes Tauri verbatim paths (`\\?\\C:\\...` and `\\?\\UNC\\...`) before passing the dsh entry, plugin patches, compatibility layer, ready file and DSH home to Node.
- Fixes the Node 24 Windows module-loader failure that reported `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, lstat 'C:'` and prevented Runtime readiness.
- Keeps reusing a compatible installed Node (`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`); the packaged Node remains the automatic fallback when the installed executable is missing, unsupported or unusable.
- Keeps all managed child processes hidden on Windows.

## Plugin and Web UI resilience

- Plugin recovery and safe-profile startup now receive normalized paths, so a third-party plugin failure cannot block the official Web UI through a path-resolution crash.
- The shell control page remains available for diagnostics and exposes the visible 外壳设置 entry; normal startup opens the isolated Harness Web UI directly.
- Optional web plugin boot failures remain degradable and do not prevent the Web UI from mounting.
